title: Broncos sign DB Sam Webb and waive CB Blake Cotton

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos sign DB Sam Webb and waive CB Blake Cotton
sources.description: On the eve of training camp officially opening, the Denver Broncos have made a minor roster move. According to reports, the team has signed defensive back Sam Webb and has waived cornerback Blake Cotton with an injury designation. Webb had a tryout with the team earlier today and impressed the coaches enough to sign him […]
